name: clipninja
description: Minimal clipboard and template manager for macOS (Cmd+Shift+V / Cmd+Shift+B).

scripts.lint: node --check src/main/main.js && node --check src/main/panel-lifecycle.js && node --check src/main/preload.js && node --check src/renderer/renderer.js && node --check src/renderer/flyout-list.js && node --check src/renderer/clipboard-flyout.js && node --check src/renderer/templates-flyout.js && node --check src/main/template-order.js && node --check src/renderer/list-reorder.js && node --check src/main/lifecycle-log.js
scripts.mac:reset-apple-events: bash -c 'echo "Resetting Apple Events (Automation) for all apps. You will be prompted again."; tccutil reset AppleEvents'

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: ClipNinja uses Automation to detect the app you were using and to paste text into its text field via System Events.
extendInfo.NSAccessibilityUsageDescription: ClipNinja needs Accessibility access to paste the selected clip into the app you were working in.
